result_preview.title: Vendor Invoice Reconciliation Agent
result_preview.shortDescription: Autonomously matches vendor invoices to POs and contracts, flags discrepancies for approval.
result_preview.description: This agent automatically reconciles incoming vendor invoices against purchase orders and master contracts using three-way matching logic. It validates line-item quantities, pricing, and terms; flags exceptions such as overbilling, duplicate invoices, or policy violations; and routes approved invoices for payment processing. This reduces manual touchpoints, accelerates cash flow, and minimizes payment disputes.

result_preview.title: Material Cost and Invoice Reconciliation Analytics
result_preview.shortDescription: Aggregates material consumption and supplier invoicing data to optimize procurement ROI.
result_preview.description: This dataProduct synthesizes Material entity consumption patterns with Invoice records to provide comprehensive financial analytics on procurement efficiency. It summarizes cost variances, supplier performance metrics, and material usage trends to support customer monetization strategies and campaign ROI optimization. The analytics enable identification of cost reduction opportunities and invoice accuracy validation across production operations.
